status: TTL task ownership and Go-shaped close verified; no overall performance gain accepted.
source_authority: Pinned client-go e4905600583b txnkv/transaction/2pc.go: ttlManager.run/close and keepAlive. Go starts a goroutine, waits for ManagedLockTTL/2 ticks, closes a channel without joining and tolerates ten consecutive transport failures before stopping on the eleventh.
change: Replace one OS thread and Condvar per transaction with a task on the existing execution runtime, a scheduler timer and a close channel. Preserve the existing synchronous TSO/heartbeat body behind block_in_place, expiry flag and failure decisions. Production close/drop no longer wait for an in-flight request; explicit async close_and_wait retains validation reports.
